How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IUST Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IUST to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IUST Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IUST Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Biochemistry, Clinical Biochemistry, Biotechnology, or Microbiology with at least 55% marks. Additionally, they must have qualified in JRF/NET/GATE/SET or an equivalent accredited examination.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 28 years. Age relaxation is provided for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow position is Rs. 37,000/- + 9% HRA per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000/- + 9% HRA per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at the Islamic University of Science & Technology (IUST).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IUST JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IUST will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted for the interview based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is contractual. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as specified in the appointment letter.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Islamic University of Science & Technology (IUST) located?
faq.answer: The Islamic University of Science & Technology (IUST) is located in Awantipora, Jammu and Kashmir, with the pincode 192122.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Jammu and Kashmir apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification does not explicitly restrict applications from outside Jammu and Kashmir. However, candidates should check the official notification for any specific domicile requirements or eligibility conditions.
